title: Taiwanese Graduate Student Association at UVa
content_html:
The Taiwanese Graduate Student Association at UVa (TGSA) is a graduate-focused student organization registered in UVA’s Presence platform. It is distinct from the undergraduate-oriented TSA at UVA and specifically serves graduate students with an interest in Taiwanese culture and community.

According to its official Presence listing, the TGSA was established to create a welcoming environment for incoming, current, and former UVa students to celebrate Taiwanese cultural heritage, and to collaborate with other Contracted Independent Organizations (CIOs) and university departments to host Taiwan-themed events on or near UVA’s grounds. A Facebook group for Taiwanese Graduate Students at the University of Virginia is also associated with this community.

No dedicated website or Instagram account was identified for the TGSA at UVA in available first-party sources. Web presence is limited primarily to its Presence directory listing and Facebook group.
